title: Scenes
summary: Full-frame hero scenes for shot storyboards: one product-UI object centred under the top caption line, dark or light canvas, timed by props (seconds from the shot start) so beats land on the spoken words.
usage: Use as a shot's full-frame background: {"background": {"piece": "scenes/score-ring", "props": {"mode": "light", "value": 4.3, "fillAt": 0.4}}}. Every time prop (…At, at) is seconds from the start of the shot; a generator script can fill them from voice/voice.json word timings.

items.name: Backdrop
items.description: The plain dark or light canvas with a breathing light at the hero spot.

items.name: Glow icon
items.description: A big app-icon tile with a breathing coloured glow, a price/name label that can be struck through, an optional stamp. User (2026-11-21): at most twice per video, and only where the thing IS an app/brand (the hook, the tool's name); never as a stand-in for an idea.

items.name: Star counter
items.description: A repo's logo tile with glow, its name, a giant star count ticking up and stat chips.

items.name: Mail card
items.description: An email card (sender, subject, body sentence) with a chip and a stamp slamming across it.

items.name: Rejection storm
items.description: Rejection notifications rain in from frame 0 and pile up, each with a red Rejected chip; a huge stamp slams across the pile with a red flash. A busy scroll-stopping hook.

items.name: Job stack
items.description: Job-posting cards dealt into a fan, stamped one after another; optional glowing AI badge.

items.name: Paste link
items.description: A big input: pointer clicks it, a link is pasted (⌘V chip, selection flash), a button pops and is pressed.

items.name: Check rows
items.description: A running-job card whose rows pop in with a spinner turning into a status chip; optional struck-through badge. badge.big: a huge floating ghost with echo trails, a red no-sign slams over it, then it bursts into wisps.

items.name: Score ring
items.description: A 270° gauge filling to a score out of N with a threshold tick; green verdict chip above it, red stamp below it. Optional: docsAt (resume and role cards scanned and wired into the ring), matches (ticked reasons), burst (rays when the fill lands).

items.name: Triage conveyor
items.description: Job cards stream up a conveyor; each is scored at a glowing judge line, low scores flash red and get flicked off left, high ones glow green and slide right; SKIP / APPLY counters tick and a stamp slams. Scores are illustrative.

items.name: Tile pool
items.description: A titled card whose glowing icon tiles pop in one per spoken item; newest tile gets a focus ring.

items.name: Document burst
items.description: One source document in the middle fires out up to four output cards to the corners along moving dashed wires, each on its spoken word; lines type in, a tick lands, the source kicks and rings each time.

items.name: Chip cloud
items.description: A giant number ticking up, surrounded by name chips; named ones pop on their words in blue.

items.name: Bubble flood
items.description: An overwhelming flood of round company bubbles (letter marks, not real logos) pouring in faster and faster until they spill past the frame; a counter on a white plate ticks up and the named companies land as big pills on their words.

items.name: Submit button
items.description: A filled form; an AI pointer stops short of Submit (lock chip), then a 'You' pointer clicks it and it turns green.

items.name: Funnel
items.description: Stage rows popping on their words, numbers ticking and bars filling (square-root widths, numbers printed); stamp at the end.

items.name: Screenshot
items.description: A real screenshot in a rounded window, slowly pushing in and panning, with chips popping under it.

items.name: Comment CTA
items.description: A comments panel: the keyword is typed and sent, lands highlighted at the top, a 'Sent! Check your DMs' reply pops.

items.name: Step rail
items.description: A numbered list of steps building one row per beat; one row lights up and a stamp slaps across it ("SKIPPED") while the others dim.

items.name: App pair
items.description: Two app tiles with an italic "or" between: the first slides aside as the second springs in. For 'use this, or that'.

items.name: Phone talk
items.description: A phone filming its user: a talking head-and-shoulders figure, REC dot and timer, live voice bars, a chip. For 'just talk to your phone'.

items.name: Scene deck
items.description: Storyboard cards dealt on arcs from below into a grid, one per beat, the newest outlined. For 'scene by scene'.

items.name: Timeline fix
items.description: A timeline of scene blocks with a sweeping playhead; a cursor taps one (Change chip), a fill runs over just that block, it turns green FIXED with a stopwatch.

items.name: Face scan
items.description: A phone with a talking figure and a caption across its face; cyan brackets lock on, the caption slides off the face and turns green, checklist rows tick.

items.name: Player scrub
items.description: A video player card: a cursor taps play, the picture cycles through scenes while the scrubber runs and time counts up.

items.name: Note fly
items.description: A sticky note types itself, folds into a paper plane that flies on a dotted arc to a scene card, which flashes Updated.

items.name: Clapper
items.description: A film clapperboard (ROLE / NAME / TAKE) whose striped stick snaps shut with a flash on the word.

items.name: Timeline kill
items.description: An old multi-track editing timeline scrubbing, slashed by a giant red X, then it tips over and drops out. Draw the negated thing, then kill it.

items.name: Clip wall
items.description: A wall of raw grey talking-head clips fans in; a Claude-orange beam sweeps across and each clip turns edited (colour, punch-in, caption, sticker, tick); optional stamp. For 'it edits all your videos'.

items.name: Before / after
items.description: One raw clip splits into Before (raw) and After (edited, playing), with an orange arrow between. For showing what an edit does.

items.name: Real clip wall
items.description: A wall of the user's real clips playing raw (desaturated, RAW tag); a Claude-orange wiper sweeps across and reveals each clip's finished edit behind the line, ticking each when done. Clips come as sprite strips (raw + edited).
